mapper.select: select count(1) from t_stock s inner join t_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' left join t_replenish_param rp on rp.product_id = s.product_id and rp.enterprise_id = s.enterprise_id where s.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and (s.qty <= 0 or (rp.safety_stock is not null and s.qty - s.locked_qty <= rp.safety_stock))
select count(1) from t_purchase_order where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '1'
select count(1) from t_payable where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and status != '2' and due_date is not null and due_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{days} day)
select count(1) from t_payable where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and status != '2' and due_date is not null and due_date < curdate()
select ifnull(sum(total_amount - paid_amount), 0) from t_payable where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and status != '2'

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as amount from t_purchase_order where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('2', '4') and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, ifnull(sum(case when record_type = '1' then qty else 0 end), 0) as inQty, ifnull(sum(case when record_type = '2' then qty else 0 end), 0) as outQty from t_stock_record where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date
